panels.description: Median of scenes added per month, across all months Stash has data for (12). The median ignores the Nov 2025 bulk import (362 scenes) that skews the mean (62).
panels.title: Median scenes/mo

panels.description: Median of images added per month, across all months Stash has data for (10, since Jan 2026). The median ignores spiky months (3,654 in Jan, 3,987 in May) that lift the mean (1,460).
panels.title: Median images/mo

panels.description: Number of scene plays recorded per day. Stash does not track image plays, so images are not included here. Scene plays only: this is not a measure of viewing time or image views.

panels.description: Performers by height range (Unknown excluded). Bars = count per bucket; line = 3-bucket centered moving average. X = lower bound of each range in cm (Under 140cm plotted at 135).
